newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Selecta sets share price at 206 Sfrs.
newsitem.headline: Selecta sets share price at 206 Sfrs.

text.p: Union Bank of Switzerland (UBS) said that it had set a 206 Swiss franc per share new issue on an initial public offering (IPO) for Swiss vending machine company Selecta.
The shares were launched on Swiss and London bourses on Monday.
The new issue price in sterling corresponded to the Swiss franc price based on current exchange rates.
Sterling opened on Monday in Zurich at 2.3006/3037 francs.
A majority stake in the company was floated by parent Swiss kiosk, speciality shop and bedding store chain Valora, which changed its name last year from Merkur. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
